summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for IsleStudio (Dynamic Island for Android), covering fluid spring-physics animations, all 4 confirmed live activity modules (Media Waveform, Timers/Stopwatch, Notifications/Battery, Navigation/Live Tracker), System Overlay + In-App Interactive Studio, precise X/Y coordinate positioning, minimalist dark aesthetic inspired by unslop principles, AES-GCM encrypted local Room persistence with offline sync queue and JSON import/export, plus a Dual Plugin Engine (Visual Action Builder & Broadcast Intent JSON API).
